forge_section.body: Every campaign begins with the list. Every list is forged in iron and resolve. Here we record each muster, each toll of the bell, and every triumph and fall — so that the marshals of the Old World may stand on the Roll of Honour, their deeds sealed in stone.

musters.heading: Active Musters
musters.empty_body: When marshals call, they will be listed here.

roll_of_honour.heading: The Roll of Honour
roll_of_honour.view_all: View the full Roll of Honour
roll_of_honour.empty_body: The forge awaits its first strike.

swiss.title: Swiss Toll
swiss.body: Every marshal plays a fixed number of tolls, paired against opponents of equal standing. No one is eliminated; the Roll decides.

bracket.title: Lineage
bracket.body: Single- and double-elimination brackets. Each engagement carves the lineage tree, until only one banner remains.

draft.title: The Choosing
draft.body: Live Captain's Mode draft. Marshals claim and forbid factions in real time — the choice is the first battle.

sigillum.heading: Join the Realm
sigillum.subline: Every list, every triumph, every fall — eternal.

login.title: Sign In
login.subtitle: Sign in with your Discord account to enter tournaments or call your own musters.

leaderboard.empty_body: Once the first marshals leave their mark, the standings appear here.

create.title: Call the Muster
create.subtitle: Create a new tournament for the Rizzotto community.
create.role_warning: You need the Organizer role to create tournaments. Contact an administrator to upgrade your role.

aside.heading: What is a Muster Call?
aside.body: A Muster Call is the formal summons to battle. You define format, mode and rules — other marshals fall in.
aside.bullet_format: The format sets the bracket structure — Single Elimination, Swiss or Round Robin.
aside.bullet_mode: The mode sets the match size — 1v1 or team encounters.
aside.bullet_draft: Optional: Enable the draft system for live picks with real-time streaming.
aside.footnote: You can edit every field after the tournament has been forged.
